locator.section: Von der Möglichkeit zur tatsächlichen Teilnahme
Four proposed cornerstones for a concrete statutory proposal

primary_reconstruction.definition: Eligible employees meet automatic-enrolment age and earnings criteria; all employees includes the noneligible group. Both are Great Britain estimates based on ASHE.
primary_reconstruction.read_limit: This verifies the denominator mismatch, not a causal effect of auto-enrolment or German reform benefits.

disposition: Do not admit as an issue at present. The factual denominator mismatch is supported, but the source addresses a Sozialpartnerdialog and asks for a future statutory proposal. No specific German federal legislative vehicle or addressed draft has been authenticated. The work is retained as a scope-pending research note.
strongest_benign_reading: A compact summary of the broad increase in workplace pension participation, combining two commonly published but differently scoped measures. A genuine large increase remains in either matched series; rounding or the word approximately does not bridge the population distinction.
materiality_if_eligible: Potential minor: the mixed comparison overstates a broad rise by eight percentage points, while the matched35point increase still strongly supports the general descriptive example.
direction_if_eligible: The exaggerated rise supports the request for automatic inclusion, but no causal attribution or optimum is established.
window: Printed author date17September2026 lies within preferred window; register recipient events are self-reported and not independently verified.
